summary: A Palestinian gunman killed two Israeli civilians and injured others in a shooting at Havat Gilad settlement in the occupied West Bank before being eliminated by IDF forces. In response, Israeli PM Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz ordered a broad crackdown including home demolition, troop reinforcements, roadblocks, and intensified operations across Judea and Samaria. Separately, Iran's IRGC warned civilians near US bases to stay 500 meters away, and reports indicate Iran rejected a ceasefire proposal from Iraq's PM.
key_points: Two Israeli civilians, including 32-year-old Benyahu Mellet, were killed and others injured in a shooting at Havat Gilad settlement in the occupied West Bank (Source: @presstv/200191).

The IDF eliminated the terrorist who carried out the attack and recovered the stolen weapon; Palestinian health officials reported four Palestinians killed and four injured (Source: @manniefabian/58842).
PM Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz ordered home demolition of the attacker, troop reinforcements, roadblocks, and intensified operations across Judea and Samaria (Source: @amitsegal/63343).
IDF Central Command chief Aluf Avi Bluth warned of possible copycat attacks and deployed forces for significant counter-terror operations following the incident (Source: @New_security8200/202945).
Iran's IRGC warned civilians in countries hosting US bases to stay at least 500 meters from 'covert US military accommodations' (Source: @shin_persian/8485).
Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that any test of Iran by Washington will receive a decisive response (Source: @naya_foriraq/85373).
Iran reportedly rejected a ceasefire proposal previously delivered to Tehran by Iraq's Prime Minister (Source: @kianmeli1/89996).

sections.executive_summary: A Palestinian gunman killed two Israeli civilians and injured others in a shooting at Havat Gilad settlement in the occupied West Bank before being eliminated by IDF forces. In response, Israeli PM Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz ordered a broad crackdown including home demolition, troop reinforcements, roadblocks, and intensified operations across Judea and Samaria. Separately, Iran's IRGC warned civilians near US bases to stay 500 meters away, and reports indicate Iran rejected a ceasefire proposal from Iraq's PM.
iran: Iran's IRGC issued a public warning to civilians in countries hosting US bases to immediately stay at least 500 meters from 'covert US military accommodations,' likely referring to hotels and military facilities (Source: @shin_persian/8485).
Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that every time Washington tests Iran, Iran delivers a decisive response, but the US continues the same approach (Source: @naya_foriraq/85373).
Iran reportedly rejected a ceasefire proposal that Iraq's Prime Minister had delivered to Tehran (Source: @kianmeli1/89996).

Multiple explosions were reported across Iran on Friday, including at least 20 consecutive explosions near Kianshahr, explosions south of Khorramabad near a Sepah base, and two explosions in Sohank mountains, with air defense activation reported in Tehran's east (Piruzi) at 03:56 (Source: @mamlekate/103988).

Explosions were reported in Khorramshahr at 4:39 AM local time, and the Iranian state media censorship bureau restricted coverage of President Pezeshkian's speech on National Industry and Mining Day (Source: @mamlekate/103988, @VahidOnline/77480).
israel: Two Israeli civilians, including 32-year-old Benyahu Mellet, were killed and others injured in a shooting at Havat Gilad settlement in the occupied West Bank (Source: @presstv/200191).
IDF forces eliminated the terrorist and recovered the stolen weapon; Palestinian health officials reported four Palestinians killed and four injured (Source: @manniefabian/58842).

PM Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz ordered demolition of the attacker's home, intensified operations in terror-hotbed villages including weapon collection and work permit revocation, troop reinforcements, roadblocks, and new settlement outposts (Source: @amitsegal/63343).

IDF Central Command chief Aluf Avi Bluth warned of possible copycat attacks and deployed additional units, stating forces are preparing for significant counter-terror operations (Source: @New_security8200/202945).

Shin Bet chief David Zini reported that the security service has thwarted dozens of attacks in recent months, nearly every night, but failed to prevent this attack in advance (Source: @amitsegal/63345).

The IDF Chief of Staff held a situational assessment with Central Command and regional commanders, ordering reinforcement of defenses and capture of all involved militants (Source: @New_security8200/202930).
gaza_west_bank: A shooting attack at Havat Gilad settlement in the occupied West Bank killed two Israeli civilians and injured others before the attacker was eliminated by IDF (Source: @presstv/200191).
Palestinian health officials reported four Palestinians killed and four injured during the incident (Source: @manniefabian/58842).

IDF forces conducted extensive operations in the village of Tell, the village of Burqin, and the village of Tuba, beginning counter-terror activity the previous evening (Source: @New_security8200/202930).
IDF troops arrested two militants who participated in the shooting during a targeted operation in the heart of Nablus, directed by Shin Bet (Source: @New_security8200/202944).
The IDF is bracing for settler retaliation against Palestinians following the deadly clash, with a military official warning of a 'climate of revenge' (Source: @manniefabian/58846).
lebanon: Lebanon issued a Red Alert for Beirut and the southern suburbs (Dahiyeh), urging maximum caution and reporting a direct map update (Source: @redlinkleb/32781).
syria_iraq: Iraq's Prime Minister reportedly delivered a ceasefire proposal to Tehran, which Iran rejected (Source: @kianmeli1/89996).
Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi stated that any test of Iran by Washington will receive a decisive response (Source: @naya_foriraq/85373).
gulf_states: Bahrain reported being targeted by Iranian attacks and urged all citizens to exercise caution and stay away from any unknown or suspicious objects (Source: @naya_foriraq/85358).

sections.threat_assessment: The Havat Gilad shooting and subsequent IDF crackdown in the West Bank raise the risk of retaliatory Palestinian attacks and settler violence against Palestinian communities. Iran's IRGC warning to civilians near US facilities, combined with the rejection of Iraq's ceasefire proposal and ongoing explosions inside Iran, suggests Tehran is maintaining a posture of calibrated escalation. The convergence of US-Israel diplomatic coordination (Netanyahu visiting Washington) and Iran's internal security posture increases the probability of a broader regional incident.
sections.regional_response: Israel is reinforcing forces across Judea and Samaria and conducting arrests and weapon seizures in Nablus, Tell, Burqin, and Tuba. Iran's IRGC is issuing public safety directives to civilians near US bases, while Bahrain has issued its own caution advisory. Iraq's reported failed ceasefire effort with Iran indicates diplomatic channels are strained. The US is deploying additional assets to the Middle East, with dozens of flights from European bases reported.
sections.intelligence_notes: The IRGC's 500-meter warning to civilians near US installations may signal prior or planned targeting of US-co-located facilities, consistent with previous attacks on hotels. The volume of explosions reported across multiple Iranian provinces on a single day warrants monitoring for patterns indicative of coordinated strikes or internal security operations. The IDF's acknowledgment that Shin Bet failed to prevent the attack despite near-daily thwarted plots suggests a possible intelligence gap or shift in Palestinian operational tactics.
